names:
  user_full shape-name-collision: shape user_full has the host name of a preset shape; rename it
   shape-name-invalid: shape name "" is not lower-case words joined by underscores; rename it, such as user_summary
  UserSummary shape-name-invalid: shape name "UserSummary" is not lower-case words joined by underscores; rename it, such as user_summary
unknown from:
  a shape-unknown: shape a: from names "users.full", which is neither a preset nor a shape under shapes:; name a preset such as user.full or a custom shape

  g shape-unknown: shape g: from names ".full", which is neither a preset nor a shape under shapes:; name a preset such as user.full or a custom shape

cycle:
  a shape-cycle: shape a depends on itself through a -> b -> a; break the cycle
self nest:
  post_tree shape-cycle: shape post_tree depends on itself through post_tree -> user_tree -> post_tree; break the cycle
unknown and forbidden fields:
  a shape-field-forbidden: shape a: pick names password_hash, which user.full leaves out (write-only); remove it from pick
  c shape-field-forbidden: shape c: nullify names password_hash, which invite binds; remove it from nullify
  a shape-field-unknown: shape a: pick names nope, which is not a field of user.full (shop.app.users); use the names of its fields
  b shape-field-unknown: shape b: require names relation author, and require applies to columns only; remove it from require
  derived invite
operators not allowed:
  a shape-operator-not-allowed: shape a: bind applies to write shapes only, and a derives from user.full; remove it
  a shape-operator-not-allowed: shape a: optionalize applies to write shapes only, and a derives from user.full; remove it
  a shape-operator-not-allowed: shape a: require applies to write shapes only, and a derives from user.full; remove it
  b shape-operator-not-allowed: shape b: nest applies to Full, Draft and Partial shapes, and b derives from user.key; remove it
conflicts:
  a shape-operator-conflict: shape a: pick names id twice; name it once
  b shape-operator-conflict: shape b: pick and omit both name id; keep one
  c shape-operator-conflict: shape c: require and optionalize both name email; keep one
  d shape-operator-conflict: shape d: nullify and nonnull both name email; keep one
  e shape-operator-conflict: shape e: nonnull names email, which the shape drops or binds; keep the field or remove it from nonnull
  f shape-operator-conflict: shape f: pick and nest both name posts_to_author; keep one
nests:
  c shape-nest-mismatch: shape c: relation author leads to shop.app.users, but tag.full is a shape of shop.app.tags; nest a shape of shop.app.users
  d shape-nest-mismatch: shape d: a Full shape cannot nest user.draft, a Draft shape; nest a Full shape of shop.app.users
  a shape-relation-unknown: shape a: nest names nope, which is not a relation of shop.app.posts; name one of author, editor, tags
  b shape-relation-unknown: shape b: nest names posts, which is not a relation of shop.app.tags; it has no relations, so remove the entry
  e shape-unknown: shape e: nest.author names "user.fancy", which is neither a preset nor a shape under shapes:; name a preset such as user.full or a custom shape
  h shape-unknown: shape h: from names "nothing", which is neither a preset nor a shape under shapes:; name a preset such as user.full or a custom shape
write rule:
  a write-shape-incomplete: shape derived from user.draft drops required field email; keep it or bind it
  a write-shape-incomplete: shape derived from user.draft drops required field password_hash; keep it or bind it
  b write-shape-incomplete: shape derived from post.draft.nested drops required field author_id; keep it or bind it
